name: Fireball deals 1+level damage to target unit
notes: Fireball's element is FIRE (matching the starting champion), so no lineage patch is needed. The starting champion's Counters are patched with 2 level counters so 'deal 1+LV damage' resolves to a nonzero-interesting 3, instead of the default level-0 base of 1. Without the [Class Bonus] discount, the full 4-reserve cost is paid.
